# Merlin — Style Reference

> Matte black phone glass, a thread of grey bubbles, one white pill to tap. A rounded grotesk at app sizes on a #000000 canvas, 1px inset rings in place of borders, and a white #ffffff pill as the only bright object on the page.

**Theme:** dark

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Merlin speaks a phone-sized chat-thread language: the marketing page is built from the same parts as the app, at the same scale. The canvas is pure #000000, cards step up to #181818, and selected rows step up again to #262628. A white #ffffff reading section mid-page inverts the stack before the browser-mockup sequence. The chromatic budget is two system hues: Cobalt #0064dc for eyebrow labels in the light section and Mint #4ade80 for completed states. The primary action is a white pill, not a brand color. Open Runde, a rounded Inter derivative, carries everything at 400 for reading and 600 for headings. The largest headline is only 28px, on a Perfect Fourth ratio (16, 21, 28), and hierarchy comes from a two-tone split between #e8e8e8 and #969696 rather than from size. Shapes run from soft to pill (24px cards, 999px buttons), and depth comes from 1px inset white rings at 6% opacity. The result reads as an app you are already holding rather than a landing page selling one.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jet Canvas | `#000000` | `--color-jet-canvas` | Body background, hero, bento section and the 30px circular icon wells — pure black lets #181818 cards read as lit glass without a single drawn border. |
| Graphite Card | `#181818` | `--color-graphite-card` | Feature cards, chat bubbles, the mega-menu panel and the avatar cutout ring (25 background uses) — a 9% lift off black is the entire elevation step. |
| Iron Tile | `#262628` | `--color-iron-tile` | Hovered People rows, menu icon wells and ribbon status chips (11 uses) — the second tonal step, used to show selection rather than containment. |
| Paper | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper` | Primary pill fill, the light reading section and avatar initials (71 background uses, 83 text uses) — the only bright object on black, so it owns the click. Do not use it as a card surface inside dark sections. |
| Carbon Label | `#0b0b0c` | `--color-carbon-label` | Label text on white pills: "Get the link" and "Email me the download link" — a hair off pure black, so the pill reads as ink pressed into paper. |
| Onyx Ink | `#171717` | `--color-onyx-ink` | Headings and strong text in the white section (39 text uses, plus 69 near-black tile backgrounds) — the light-mode inverse of Fog Ink. |
| Slate Body | `#3f3f3f` | `--color-slate-body` | 16px explainer paragraphs in the white section and dark glyphs on white icon buttons (20 uses) — softer than Onyx, so long copy reads as reading text. |
| Ash Meta | `#707070` | `--color-ash-meta` | "Free forever. No credit card." fine print, timestamps and the grey second line of light-section headings (48 uses) — the tertiary metadata step. |
| Pewter Caption | `#969696` | `--color-pewter-caption` | Feature-card descriptions, the second line of dark headings, ghost nav buttons and avatar fills (73 text uses) — the secondary voice that makes two-tone headlines work. |
| Fog Ink | `#e8e8e8` | `--color-fog-ink` | Headlines, bubble copy, the nav wordmark and list names (156 uses, the most frequent color on the page) — off-white lowers glare against #000000. |
| Frosted Hairline | `#ffffff1a` | `--color-frosted-hairline` | 1px borders on dividers and chips in dark sections (9 uses) — 10% white is the only literal border; most edges are inset rings instead. |
| Cobalt Eyebrow | `#0064dc` | `--color-cobalt-eyebrow` | Eyebrow labels in the white section such as "Who needs you" and "Book Mom's flights on" (14 uses) — the single chromatic label color. Do not promote it to a CTA fill. |
| Mint Pulse | `#4ade80` | `--color-mint-pulse` | Completed-state check badges on avatars and the agent cursor dot inside browser mockups (17 uses) — green means Merlin already did it. Do not use it for buttons. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Open Runde — the single voice for headlines, UI and reading copy · `--font-open-runde`

- **Substitute:** Open Runde itself is OFL-licensed and self-hostable at 400/500/600/700. Inter at 400/500/600 matches the stroke one-to-one but loses the rounded terminals. Nunito Sans (variable) at 450/550/650 keeps the rounded feel; it draws lighter than its nominal weight, so push it 50 units heavier.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 8.5px, 10px, 10.5px, 11px, 11.5px, 12px, 12.5px, 13px, 13.5px, 14px, 15px, 15.5px, 16px, 19px, 21px, 28px
- **Line height:** 1.15 (28px), 1.2 (21px), 1.3 (19px), 1.4 (12px, 15.5px), 1.45 (13.5px), 1.6 (13px, 15px), 1.65 (16px)
- **Letter spacing:** -0.98px at 28px, -0.63px at 21px, -0.42px at 19px, -0.225px at 15px semibold, -0.24px at 16px semibold, -0.16px at every body size, +0.26px at 13px medium labels, +0.3px at 15px medium labels
- **Role:** Weight 600 at 28px is the ceiling. Where a conventional SaaS hero runs 56 to 72px at 700, Merlin stops at 28px because the product is a chat window and the page refuses to shout louder than the app. The scale ascends 16 → 21 → 28, a textbook Perfect Fourth (1.333), but it sits on such a small base that the top step is only modest. Body tracking is a fixed -0.16px at every size rather than a proportional em, so small text tightens slightly more than large text, which is the iOS habit. Positive +0.26px tracking appears only on 13px medium labels, to keep them legible at micro sizes.

### Open Runde Tabular — fixed-width figures for timestamps and counters · `--font-open-runde-tabular`

- **Substitute:** Open Runde at 500 with tabular numerals enabled, Inter at 500 with tabular numerals, Nunito Sans at 550 with tabular numerals.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 14px
- **Line height:** 1
- **Letter spacing:** -0.16px at 14px
- **Role:** A dedicated tabular cut (35 uses at 500) keeps clock times like "13:03" from jittering as call timers tick. The line height of 1 locks the figures into chip rows. Splitting tabular figures into their own family, rather than toggling a feature, signals that numbers are live UI here and not prose.

### -apple-system — native micro-labels and mockup chrome · `--font-apple-system`

- **Substitute:** system-ui at native weights, Inter at 400/500, Roboto at 400/500 on Android.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 10px, 10.5px, 12.5px
- **Line height:** 1.3
- **Letter spacing:** -0.16px at 10px, 10.5px and 12.5px
- **Role:** The system font handles 10px micro-labels (26 uses) and in-mockup OS chrome. Handing those to San Francisco makes the embedded screens read as real macOS windows rather than illustrations. It is deliberately not used above 12.5px.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | -apple-system | 400 | 10px | 1.3 | -0.16px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Open Runde | 400 | 12px | 1.4 | -0.16px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Open Runde | 400 | 13.5px | 1.45 | -0.16px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Open Runde | 400 | 15.5px | 1.4 | -0.16px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Open Runde | 400 | 16px | 1.65 | -0.16px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Open Runde | 600 | 15px | 1.6 | -0.225px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Open Runde | 600 | 19px | 1.3 | -0.42px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Open Runde | 600 | 21px | 1.2 | -0.63px | `--text-heading` |
| display | Open Runde | 600 | 28px | 1.15 | -0.98px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Cap headlines at 28px weight 600 with -0.98px tracking — the page speaks at app volume, and that ceiling is the signature.
- Split every section heading into two lines, #e8e8e8 then #969696 — tone, not size, carries the subtitle.
- Separate dark surfaces with a 1px inset ring at rgba(255,255,255,0.06) — edges stay inside the card, so stacked cards do not double their borders.
- Fill the primary action with #ffffff and #0b0b0c text at 999px radius — on #000000, white is the maximum contrast available, so no brand hue is needed.
- Keep the hero inside a 400px column, matching chat bubbles to the 52px CTA — the hero is a conversation, and conversations are narrow.
- Track all body copy at a fixed -0.16px from 10px to 16px — one absolute value reproduces the native iOS texture across every small size.
- Restrict Mint #4ade80 to completed states and Cobalt #0064dc to light-section eyebrows — two hues with two jobs is non-negotiable for keeping meaning legible.

### Don't

- Don't inflate the hero to a 64px display headline — the thesis is app-scale type, and a marketing-sized H1 turns the chat thread into a backdrop instead of the product.
- Don't swap the white pill for a #4ade80 or #0064dc fill — color then means "click" instead of "done" or "label", and the two-hue budget collapses.
- Don't draw 1px #ffffff1a borders around every card — the 6% inset ring is the edge, and solid borders make 24px cards read as form fields.
- Don't nest a lighter #262628 panel inside a feature card for stored data — records sink into #000000 wells, and lifting them reverses the depth logic.
- Don't add drop shadows like 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.4) to static cards — the system reserves real shadows for the floating mega-menu, avatars and cursor.
- Don't set long-form copy in #969696 on the white section — 16px paragraphs use #3f3f3f, and Pewter on white falls to roughly 3:1 contrast.
- Don't square off pills to 8px — buttons, chips and badges are 999px, and a never-rounded-enough capsule breaks the bubble vocabulary the hero establishes.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #000000 (Jet Canvas)
- card surface: #181818 (Graphite Card)
- primary text: #e8e8e8 (Fog Ink)
- secondary text: #969696 (Pewter Caption)
- hairline: #ffffff1a (Frosted Hairline)
- completed state: #4ade80 (Mint Pulse)
- primary action: #ffffff (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts use neutral bars in #262628 with the active series in #969696, and Mint #4ade80 appears only as a solid fill marking completed or confirmed values, so the white CTA stays the brightest object on any page.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a primary action button: a pill with background #ffffff, text color #0b0b0c, no border, border-radius 999px, padding 0 24px, height 52px and width 400px. Place a 16px envelope icon 8px before the label "Email me the download link" in Open Runde at 16px, weight 600, letter-spacing -0.16px. Add no shadow. On hover, keep the fill and apply the inset ring `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)`. Below it, 12px down, center the caption "Free forever. No credit card." in Open Runde at 12px, weight 400, line-height 1.4, color #707070.

2. Build a hero section on background #000000: a centered column with max-width 400px and 120px top padding. Stack three chat bubbles with 6px gaps. Each bubble has background #181818, text #e8e8e8 in Open Runde at 15.5px, weight 400, line-height 1.4, letter-spacing -0.16px, padding 10px 15px and border-radius 20px. Give the last bubble border-radius 20px 20px 20px 7px. Place a 32px circular avatar left of the last bubble with a 2px #181818 ring (`0 0 0 2px #181818`). Below, 24px down, add the 400px white pill CTA from prompt 1.

3. Build a feature card: background #181818, border-radius 24px, padding 0, box-shadow `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)`, no border, in a three-column grid with 12px gaps inside a 900px container. The top area holds a product demo flush to the edges. Beneath it, add a title in Open Runde at 15px, weight 600, line-height 1.6, letter-spacing -0.225px, color #e8e8e8, padding 0 24px, then a description at 13.5px, weight 400, line-height 1.45, color #969696, padding 0 24px 24px. Above the grid, center a two-line heading at 28px, weight 600, letter-spacing -0.98px: line one #e8e8e8, line two #969696.

4. Build a navigation bar 60px tall, transparent over #000000, not sticky, aligned to a 900px container. On the left, place a 20px line-drawn logo glyph and "merlin.computer" in Open Runde at 15px, weight 600, color #e8e8e8. On the right, with 8px gaps, add a ghost pill "Features" (transparent, #969696 text, 13px weight 500, padding 0 11px, height 32px, radius 999px, #262628 fill on hover), a matching "Pricing" pill, and a white pill "Get the link" (#ffffff fill, #0b0b0c text, padding 0 14px, height 32px, radius 999px). "Features" opens a panel with background #181818, radius 22px, padding 8px and the shadow `--shadow-xl`, containing two columns of rows with 14px radius and 9px 10px padding.

### Pill Button — Large Download CTA

**Role:** The single hero conversion action

The hero's only full-width object. It takes a #ffffff fill and #0b0b0c text, no border, 999px radius, 0 24px padding, and a fixed 52px height at a 400px width, matching the chat column exactly. A leading envelope glyph sits before Open Runde at 16px weight 600 with -0.16px tracking, with no shadow. Locking it to the 400px column makes it read as the reply field at the bottom of a conversation rather than a banner button.

### Ghost Pill — Nav Secondary

**Role:** Quiet secondary navigation trigger

Text that becomes a button on hover. It is transparent, with #969696 text, no border, 999px radius, 0 11px padding and a 32px height, set in Open Runde at 13px weight 500 with a trailing chevron. Its hover state picks up an #262628 fill. Secondary actions are distinguished by text color alone, Pewter against the primary's Paper fill, which keeps the nav to exactly one filled object.

### Navigation Bar

**Role:** Wordmark left, actions right

A 60px strip that is not sticky. It sits transparent over #000000 with no bottom border and is aligned to the 900px content column. On the left is the line-drawn face glyph plus "merlin.computer" in Open Runde at 15px weight 600 in #e8e8e8. On the right are the Features ghost pill, Pricing, and the white "Get the link" pill, all on 13px weight 500 text. The bar scrolls away with the page, which is anti-convention for a SaaS header and keeps the chat hero uncluttered.

### Mega-Menu Panel

**Role:** Features dropdown, two-column directory

A floating Graphite sheet. It uses a #181818 fill, 22px radius and 8px padding, with the composite `--shadow-xl` (inset 8% white ring, 1px top highlight, and a 0 30px 60px -24px black drop). It holds a two-column grid of rows, each with 14px radius, 9px 10px padding, a 13px weight 500 #e8e8e8 title and a 12px #969696 description, led by a colored icon tile. This is the one surface that earns a real drop shadow, because it is the one surface that floats above content.

### Feature Card — Bento

**Role:** Main content card, demo plus caption

A dark window holding a live demo. It uses a #181818 fill, 24px radius, 0 padding on the container and the 1px inset ring `--shadow-sm` (6% white), with no outer shadow. The mockup fills the top, and below it sit a 15px weight 600 #e8e8e8 title at 0 24px padding and a 13.5px #969696 body at 0 24px 24px padding. The grid runs three columns with a two-column span below. Zero container padding lets the demo bleed edge to edge, so the card reads as a screen rather than a box.

### Chat Bubble — Merlin Voice

**Role:** Hero copy delivered as messages

The hero headline replaced by a thread. Each bubble uses a #181818 fill and #e8e8e8 text in Open Runde at 15.5px weight 400 on a 1.4 line height, with 10px 15px padding and a 20px radius, and is capped at 400px. The last bubble breaks the radius to 20px 20px 20px 7px, cutting a tail toward the avatar. That tail is the system outlier, allowed because it is the one shape that says "message" faster than any copy could.

### Status Ribbon Pill

**Role:** Marquee of completed errands

Small proof chips. They sit on a translucent dark fill, estimated from screenshots as #262628, with a 999px radius and 5px 16px 5px 5px padding (normalized from a measured 17px right pad). Each carries a leading brand or initials circle and two lines: a 13px weight 600 #e8e8e8 title over a 12px #969696 status. The pills are stacked in two tilted rows with edge blur. Content does the decorating here: real outcomes such as "Running shoes · Shipped" replace the conventional logo wall.

### Initials Avatar

**Role:** Person identity in lists

A flat grey coin. It uses a #969696 fill, #ffffff initials in Open Runde at 8.5px weight 500 with +0.17px tracking, and a 50% radius at a 22px diameter in stacks. It scales up to list size in the People card and carries `--shadow-md-2`, a 2px #181818 ring that cuts it out of overlapping neighbors. A #4ade80 check badge marks people Merlin has handled. Grey avatars keep faces neutral, so the green badge is the only signal.

### Record Tile

**Role:** Filed memory inside a card

A black well inside a grey card. It uses a #000000 fill, 16px radius, 10px 12px padding and the inset ring `--shadow-sm-2` at 8% white. It holds a 12px #969696 uppercase category over 15.5px #e8e8e8 content such as "Biscuit (dog)". Stepping down to black rather than up to a lighter grey inverts the usual nesting convention: stored data sinks into the card like an inset slot.

### Two-Tone Section Heading

**Role:** Headline with built-in subtitle

Two lines, two inks, one size. The heading is Open Runde at 28px weight 600 on a 1.15 line height with -0.98px tracking. Line one is #e8e8e8 and line two #969696 on dark sections. On white, line one is #171717 and line two #707070 (estimated). Centered in the bento section and left-aligned in the mockup section, it replaces the conventional H2-plus-gray-subtitle pair with a single sentence whose second half recedes.

### Eyebrow Paragraph Pair

**Role:** Explainer grid in light section

A labelled paragraph. The eyebrow is Open Runde at 13px weight 600 in #0064dc, sitting 8px above a body-lg paragraph at 16px weight 400 with a 1.65 line height in #3f3f3f, on a #ffffff canvas. Pairs are laid out in a two-column grid with 64px row gaps. This is the only place blue appears as type, so the light section reads as a documentation page next to the dark demo section.

### Browser Mockup Frame

**Role:** Agent-in-action product proof

A browser window held in a colored tray. The outer tray uses a 28px radius and a decorative gradient (sky blue for the Qatar demo, silver for the Amazon demo, both not system tokens). It holds a #ffffff browser window with a 20px radius, a traffic-light bar and a URL pill. The tray takes a #4ade80 cursor dot, and the caption below pairs a #0064dc eyebrow with a 15.5px #3f3f3f paragraph. The gradient is permitted only here, because the frames depict third-party sites, not Merlin's own chrome.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Cap headlines at 28px weight 600 with -0.98px tracking — the page speaks at app volume, and that ceiling is the signature.
- Split every section heading into two lines, #e8e8e8 then #969696 — tone, not size, carries the subtitle.
- Separate dark surfaces with a 1px inset ring at rgba(255,255,255,0.06) — edges stay inside the card, so stacked cards do not double their borders.
- Fill the primary action with #ffffff and #0b0b0c text at 999px radius — on #000000, white is the maximum contrast available, so no brand hue is needed.
- Keep the hero inside a 400px column, matching chat bubbles to the 52px CTA — the hero is a conversation, and conversations are narrow.
- Track all body copy at a fixed -0.16px from 10px to 16px — one absolute value reproduces the native iOS texture across every small size.
- Restrict Mint #4ade80 to completed states and Cobalt #0064dc to light-section eyebrows — two hues with two jobs is non-negotiable for keeping meaning legible.

### Don't

- Don't inflate the hero to a 64px display headline — the thesis is app-scale type, and a marketing-sized H1 turns the chat thread into a backdrop instead of the product.
- Don't swap the white pill for a #4ade80 or #0064dc fill — color then means "click" instead of "done" or "label", and the two-hue budget collapses.
- Don't draw 1px #ffffff1a borders around every card — the 6% inset ring is the edge, and solid borders make 24px cards read as form fields.
- Don't nest a lighter #262628 panel inside a feature card for stored data — records sink into #000000 wells, and lifting them reverses the depth logic.
- Don't add drop shadows like 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.4) to static cards — the system reserves real shadows for the floating mega-menu, avatars and cursor.
- Don't set long-form copy in #969696 on the white section — 16px paragraphs use #3f3f3f, and Pewter on white falls to roughly 3:1 contrast.
- Don't square off pills to 8px — buttons, chips and badges are 999px, and a never-rounded-enough capsule breaks the bubble vocabulary the hero establishes.

## Imagery

There is no photography and no illustration: every visual is a working product screenshot rebuilt in HTML. Bento cards hold live UI (a People list, a call transcript, a mini browser cart) flush to the card's 24px edges with no inner frame. The light section embeds third-party sites (Qatar Airways, Amazon) inside #ffffff browser windows set in 28px gradient trays. Those gradients and the sites' own maroon, orange and yellow are mockup-internal, not system tokens, and the Lato face inside them is mockup-internal too. Icons are small rounded-square app tiles at a 12% radius, plus a line-drawn face glyph for the logo. A #4ade80 cursor dot marks where the agent is acting, and a #c47ad4 status dot in lists is decorative only. The narrative is an assistant shown doing errands, not described doing them.

## Layout

Content sits in a 900px column with the hero narrowed to 400px. Sections are separated by roughly 120px of black. The hero is a centered chat thread of three #181818 bubbles beside a small Merlin avatar, followed by the 52px white download pill and #707070 fine print, then a full-bleed tilted two-row marquee of status pills. The dark bento follows: a centered two-tone heading and a three-column grid with a two-column span beneath it. The canvas then flips to #ffffff for a two-column eyebrow-paragraph grid, a hairline divider with a squiggle and caps label, and a 1:2 split pairing a left heading with a stack of right-hand browser mockups. The nav is 60px, transparent and not sticky, with the wordmark left and actions right, and an "Ask Merlin" chip floats top-left. The footer is minimal. At 375px, keep display at 28px, use 64px section gaps and collapse grids to one column. Density: compact.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #000000 (Jet Canvas)
- card surface: #181818 (Graphite Card)
- primary text: #e8e8e8 (Fog Ink)
- secondary text: #969696 (Pewter Caption)
- hairline: #ffffff1a (Frosted Hairline)
- completed state: #4ade80 (Mint Pulse)
- primary action: #ffffff (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts use neutral bars in #262628 with the active series in #969696, and Mint #4ade80 appears only as a solid fill marking completed or confirmed values, so the white CTA stays the brightest object on any page.

**Example Component Prompts**

Place a 16px envelope icon 8px before the label "Email me the download link" in Open Runde at 16px, weight 600, letter-spacing -0.16px. Add no shadow. On hover, keep the fill and apply the inset ring `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)`. Below it, 12px down, center the caption "Free forever. No credit card." in Open Runde at 12px, weight 400, line-height 1.4, color #707070.

2. Build a hero section on background #000000: a centered column with max-width 400px and 120px top padding. Stack three chat bubbles with 6px gaps. Each bubble has background #181818, text #e8e8e8 in Open Runde at 15.5px, weight 400, line-height 1.4, letter-spacing -0.16px, padding 10px 15px and border-radius 20px. Give the last bubble border-radius 20px 20px 20px 7px. Place a 32px circular avatar left of the last bubble with a 2px #181818 ring (`0 0 0 2px #181818`). Below, 24px down, add the 400px white pill CTA from prompt 1.

3. Build a feature card: background #181818, border-radius 24px, padding 0, box-shadow `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)`, no border, in a three-column grid with 12px gaps inside a 900px container. The top area holds a product demo flush to the edges. Beneath it, add a title in Open Runde at 15px, weight 600, line-height 1.6, letter-spacing -0.225px, color #e8e8e8, padding 0 24px, then a description at 13.5px, weight 400, line-height 1.45, color #969696, padding 0 24px 24px. Above the grid, center a two-line heading at 28px, weight 600, letter-spacing -0.98px: line one #e8e8e8, line two #969696.

On the left, place a 20px line-drawn logo glyph and "merlin.computer" in Open Runde at 15px, weight 600, color #e8e8e8. On the right, with 8px gaps, add a ghost pill "Features" (transparent, #969696 text, 13px weight 500, padding 0 11px, height 32px, radius 999px, #262628 fill on hover), a matching "Pricing" pill, and a white pill "Get the link" (#ffffff fill, #0b0b0c text, padding 0 14px, height 32px, radius 999px). "Features" opens a panel with background #181818, radius 22px, padding 8px and the shadow `--shadow-xl`, containing two columns of rows with 14px radius and 9px 10px padding.

## App-Scale Restraint

The discipline is that the website runs at the product's own scale: 28px is the largest headline, 400px is the hero width, and the hero headline is literally a chat bubble at 15.5px. This works only while nothing on the page outranks the app. It breaks the moment someone adds a 56px display line, a 1200px hero image or a gradient banner, because the bubbles shrink into decoration around a conventional landing page. To extend the system, add new sections as more product surfaces at the same scale: a new feature becomes a new 24px bento card or a new browser mockup. When a section needs more emphasis, give it more whitespace (120px) or invert the canvas to #ffffff, not more type size.

## Rings, Not Borders

Every dark edge on Merlin is drawn inside the shape: `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)` on cards and a 1px top highlight at 6% on chips. Real drop shadows are rationed to the floating menu, cursor and avatar cutouts. Solid 1px #ffffff1a borders appear only 9 times, on dividers. This breaks if outer borders are added, since they double up where cards abut and add a pixel to every measurement. It also breaks if shadows land on static cards, which on #000000 render as muddy halos with nothing to cast onto. To extend it, raise opacity in steps (6%, 8%, 12%) for stronger emphasis, and use the black-ring variant at 6% on the white section.

## Two-Tone Hierarchy

Hierarchy on Merlin is carried by ink, not by scale. Section headings put the claim in #e8e8e8 and the qualifier in #969696 at the identical 28px weight 600. List rows pair a #e8e8e8 name with a #969696 status. Cards pair a 15px title with a 13.5px grey description. The system depends on exactly three dark-mode text steps (#e8e8e8, #969696, #707070), with #171717, #3f3f3f and #707070 mirroring them on white. Introducing a fourth grey such as #b0b0b0 breaks it, and so does bolding the second line, which turns one sentence into two competing headlines. Extend it by using the second tone for whatever is contextual: dates, statuses, subtitles.

## Similar Brands

- **Raycast** — Shares the near-black canvas, rounded app-tile icons and inset 1px rings on dark panels. Raycast scales its hero type much larger and leans on a red brand gradient.
- **Linear** — Shares tonal layering on dark surfaces with hairline inner rings instead of borders. Linear uses a violet accent and much larger display type.
- **Granola** — The same category of AI note-taking and personal assistant, with an equally small-type, product-first page. Granola sits on a warm light canvas rather than #000000.
- **Arc (The Browser Company)** — Shares the rounded, consumer-warm voice and demos built from live browser chrome. Arc spends far more color and illustration.
- **Superhuman** — Shares the keyboard-first assistant positioning and restrained dark UI with one bright action. Superhuman uses a serif display face where Merlin keeps one rounded sans.
